text:
Maria H.: heads-up — PR evals started failing at scale this morning. GH Actions fires, then buildkite webhook stalls during handshake for ~30s and we get timeouts. Seen across ~8 PRs in quick succession.
Kevin L.: ugh. any error codes in the logs?
Maria H.: mainly 504/timeout from our proxy, and on the BK side we see duplicate webhook receipts then one of them hangs. snippet: `POST /hook 202 / 504 after 30s`
Sophie R.: did we hit the runner quota? Buildkite agent pool was at 100% for ~3m around that time.
Jordan P.: yep, autoscaler maxed. Lots of small PRs triggered the full eval matrix. We also accidentally included `paths: ["**"]` in the GH workflow so everything triggered.
Maria H.: oof. that's the immediate bug. I can patch the GH action to only run when `model/**` or `eval/**` files change.
Kevin L.: good call. also we should add a debounce/jitter layer before calling BK. thundering herd is real.
Samir K.: proposal: GH Actions -> debounce lambda that dedups identical PR payloads for 20s, adds random 0-6s jitter, then forwards to Buildkite. also check `X-Buildkite-Webhook-Id` to avoid double-processing.
Maria H.: sounds reasonable. any objections to a short-lived cache?
Sophie R.: +1. Also we need a fast smoke gate that returns quickly so GH PR shows checks passing/failing before the full matrix completes. If smoke fails, skip heavy runs.
Jordan P.: we have a tiny smoke eval subset we can run in <30s. We should wire that as a separate `check_run` early. GH Actions can call it inline before enqueuing BK.
Kevin L.: example GH conditional:```yaml
on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'model/**'
      - 'eval/**'
jobs:
  smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: ./scripts/run-smoke-eval.sh
  enqueue:
    needs: smoke
    if: success() && github.event.pull_request.changed_files > 0
    uses: ./actions/enqueue-buildkite
```
Samir K.: small nit: `github.event.pull_request.changed_files` isn't available in push events. better to use `paths` + a small python check to avoid edge cases.
Maria H.: noted. I'll update.
Sophie R.: regarding BK handshake stalls — logs show TLS renegotiation on our side. maybe proxy config is dropping keepalives under load.
Samir K.: will check proxy keepalive settings. we had aggressive connection close on idle set earlier. might be killing the BK connection when multiple webhooks reuse sockets.
Jordan P.: while Samir looks into infra, we should make the enqueue step resilient: retry with exponential backoff and a circuit-breaker that falls back to a lighter job (e.g., enqueue only smoke jobs).
Maria H.: agree. Also add an alert if webhook avg latency > 5s for > 5m so we catch next surge.
Kevin L.: for the PR gating metric we want: percent of PRs where smoke eval completed within 60s, and percent where full eval enqueued successfully within 120s. We can emit these to Datadog from the lambda.
Sophie R.: and a dashboard panel showing active BK agents and queue depth mapped to PR enqueue rate. that'll help correlate.
Maria H.: listeners: can someone take action items? I can: patch GH Actions paths and add smoke step (PR incoming). Samir: can you adjust proxy keepalives and look at BK webhook handling? Jordan: add circuit-breaker and retry wrapper in enqueue action. Kevin: create Datadog metrics + dashboard panel. Sophie: put together the smoke eval set and script.
Samir K.: on it — will also add logs for `X-Buildkite-Webhook-Id` to help trace duplicates.
ci-bot: Deploy job scheduled: `infra/proxy/keepalive-tweak` (dry-run) — started by Samir K.
Kevin L.: tiny followup — should we gate PR runs on base branch status? sometimes we get rebase storms.
Maria H.: good point. let's require base branch to be green OR `force-eval` label present. will add to GH workflow.
Jordan P.: one more: make sure artifact upload uses dedup keys so multiple concurrent evals don't flood storage. use `model:sha` as key.
Sophie R.: sounds good. I'll create the smoke eval PR and link it here when ready. :thumbsup:
Maria H.: thanks all. I'll open the GH patch now and tag reviewers.
Kevin L.: thanks — this should cut the noise a lot. :party_parrot:
